headline: Supply Chain and Production Planning Officer
summary: Supply chain and production planning officer with six years at a vegetable-processing company in Baguio. I plan supply from farms to the plant, manage inventory and warehouse stock, plan transport routes from the highlands, and work with production on schedules and quality. I sit between the supply chain and manufacturing teams.

experience.title: Supply Chain and Production Planning Officer
experience.paragraph: Plan supply, stock and production for a plant making frozen and pickled vegetables.
bullets: Plan weekly raw material supply from 300 contract farmers in Benguet.
Manage stock in the cold store and dry warehouse and keep inventory accuracy above 98%.
Plan truck routes from farm collection points down to the plant and to Manila customers.
Monitor daily production against plan and check quality results with the QA team.

experience.title: Inventory Planner
experience.paragraph: Planned produce collection and storage for a farmers' cooperative.
bullets: Kept stock records of vegetables in cold storage and planned releases to buyers.
Planned collection routes around the trading post schedule.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering
